ceu: ✦ The sextile between Venus and Neptune

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
From {H:1829494833000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Thank someone who supports you and rarely hears a thank-you.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
From {H:1829494833000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Take a real lunch break, without screens.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
From {H:1829494833000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Listen to a song you love and let yourself go.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.
From {H:1829494833000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Light a candle at the end of the day and give thanks for your home.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
From {H:1829494833000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to home and family.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to someone you come across.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.
From {H:1829494833000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
From {H:1829494833000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
From {H:1829494833000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, family and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
From {H:1829494833000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
From {H:1829494833000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, money and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
From {H:1829494833000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
From {H:1829494833000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.
